high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a news article from the app "Inshorts." The headline reads: "US tests magnetised cement that can charge EVs as they drive." Below the headline, there is a description of the story, which states that Indiana's Department of Transport is testing a new type of cement with embedded magnetized particles that can wirelessly charge electric vehicles as they drive. The cement will be tested in a lab in two phases and then on a quarter-mile-long road for testing. After completing the tests, a segment of an interstate highway within Indiana will be electrified.
